name: v59_product_focus_low_complexity
hypothesis: Companies with fewer key and terminal product sectors may be easier to price and manage; this tests product-complexity structure without relationship-return residuals.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_revere_key_sector_total, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_revere_term_sector_total, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_all, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: No rel_ret, no competitor/customer authority, no accounting quality; checks whether product focus itself carries low-corr signal.

name: v59_ecosystem_breadth_without_returns
hypothesis: Broad partner/product overlap net of direct competitors may indicate ecosystem reach without using the crowded related-return channel.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part - rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_all - rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_revere_key_sector_total, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Count-only relationship breadth; strict corr gate vs QPa7KOGK and 58wgxOM1.

name: v59_competitive_crowding_deconcentration
hypothesis: Lower competitor breadth and lower competitor graph centrality may identify less crowded competitive positions, distinct from the existing positive competitor-authority alpha.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_com_page_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_ompetitorgraphrank_hub_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Opposite structural premise from competitor hub/authority actives; no earnings news or return residual.

name: v59_customer_diversification_no_return
hypothesis: More customers with lower customer graph concentration may represent diversified demand, avoiding the crowded customer-return spillover expression.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_cust, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_ustomergraphrank_page_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: No rel_ret_cust; deliberately structural to test whether customer diversification has standalone signal.

name: v59_insider_news_accumulation_lowrisk
hypothesis: Positive insider-trading news sentiment and impact may proxy management confidence outside recommendations, price targets, product/business news, and earnings news.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_insider, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_insider, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_insider, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Non-product, non-earnings RP theme; prior insider+recommendation was weak, so this isolates insider sentiment.

name: v59_short_interest_decrowding
hypothesis: Falling short interest and low short crowding may capture covering pressure or lower negative-information risk, but without option-flow confirmation or accounting quality anchors.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(news_short_interest, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: One controlled short-interest retest; prior short-interest mainline was weak, so do not rescue unless clearly near gate and low-corr.

name: v59_iv_skew_term_structure_no_reversal
hypothesis: A calmer short-vs-long option skew term structure may capture downside-demand normalization without using breakeven, PCR volume curve, close/open reversal, or fundamentals.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs((implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60) - (implied_volatility_put_180 - implied_volatility_call_180)), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * implied_volatility_mean_skew_60, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Non-breakeven option structure; strict corr gate vs 0m7p1Lb1, QPa7KOGK, akdbG2k5, and 6XwKxVkO.

name: v59_call_iv_upside_demand
hypothesis: Call implied volatility above put implied volatility may represent upside option demand rather than defensive skew, potentially distinct from existing skew and breakeven actives.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(implied_volatility_call_60 - implied_volatility_put_60, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(implied_volatility_call_180 - implied_volatility_put_180, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: No breakeven, IV risk premium, PCR curve, or reversal parent; only submit if corr is comfortably below option actives.

name: v59_bfl_quality_value_product_peer
hypothesis: BFL quality/value/growth scores may become more useful when compared inside product peers rather than industry or subindustry buckets.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_quality, 126), pv13_hierarchy_min20_3k_sector) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_value, 126), pv13_hierarchy_min20_3k_sector) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_growth, 126), pv13_hierarchy_min20_3k_sector) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: A BFL retest with pv13 product peer comparison; no model16 analyst_revision derivative or accounting ratios.

name: v59_volume_return_absorption
hypothesis: Stocks where returns and relative volume are less positively coupled may have less momentum-chasing flow; this is a non-close-location technical statistic.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_corr(returns, volume / adv20, 20), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(returns) * volume / adv20, 20), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Avoids close/open, close-location, VWAP pressure, option, news, graph, and analyst fields.
